channel.title: Walter's Home Check — Guides
channel.description: Free home guides from Walter's Home Check: buying red flags, seasonal checklists, home systems and older-home issues, in plain English.

item.title: Aluminum Wiring in Homes: What It Means and What to Ask
item.description: Aluminum wiring in homes from the mid-1960s to mid-1970s: how to spot it, warning signs at outlets, and why repairs belong to a licensed electrician.

item.title: Asbestos in Older Homes: Where It Hides and Why You Leave It Alone
item.description: Asbestos in older homes: common materials like old floor tiles, pipe wrap, vermiculite and popcorn ceilings, why to leave them alone, and testing.

item.title: Attic Ventilation Basics: How Your Attic Should Breathe
item.description: Attic ventilation basics: what intake and exhaust vents do, signs your attic isn't breathing, what to check safely, and when to call a roofer.

item.title: Buying an Older Home Checklist: 7 Things to Check
item.description: A buying an older home checklist for houses built before 1990: wiring, panels, pipes, sewer line, lead paint, asbestos and radon — and who to call.

item.title: Dryer Vent Cleaning: Why It Matters and Signs You're Overdue
item.description: Dryer vent cleaning explained: why lint buildup is a fire risk, signs your vent is clogged, what you can check yourself, and when to call a pro.

item.title: How to Clean Gutters and Fix Drainage: A Fall Guide
item.description: How to clean gutters and fix drainage around your house this fall: ladder safety, downspouts, grading and when to call a gutter pro or roofer instead.

item.title: Foundation Crack Types: Which Ones to Worry About
item.description: Foundation crack types explained in plain English: hairline, vertical, stair-step and horizontal cracks, which are normal, and when to call an engineer.

item.title: Furnace Warning Signs You Shouldn't Ignore
item.description: Furnace warning signs to watch for, which ones mean call a technician today, and the carbon monoxide safety steps every home with a furnace needs.

item.title: GFCI Outlets Explained: What They Do and How to Test Them
item.description: What a GFCI outlet does, where your house should have them, how to test one with the TEST and RESET buttons, and when to call an electrician.

item.title: Home Maintenance Calendar: A Simple Month-by-Month Plan
item.description: A home maintenance calendar for the whole year, January to December: small monthly jobs, seasonal checks and when to book a pro, in plain English.

item.title: House Red Flags at a Showing: 7 Things to Notice
item.description: House red flags you can spot at a showing in 30 minutes: water, foundation cracks, roof wear, old wiring and more — and when to call a pro.

item.title: How Long Does a Roof Last? Signs Yours Is Near the End
item.description: How long does a roof last? Typical lifespans by roof type, the warning signs you can spot safely from the ground, and when to call a roofer.

item.title: How to Spot a Bad House Flip Before You Buy
item.description: How to spot a bad flip: fresh finishes over old systems, missing permits, hidden water and rushed work — what to check yourself and when to call a pro.

item.title: How to Test a Sump Pump (the Safe Bucket Test)
item.description: How to test a sump pump with a simple bucket of water, what a healthy pump should do, warning signs to watch for, and when to call a plumber.

item.title: Knob and Tube Wiring: How to Spot It and What to Do About It
item.description: Knob and tube wiring explained: how to recognize it in an older house, why insurers and electricians ask about it, and what to leave to an electrician.

item.title: Lead Paint in Older Homes: What Buyers and Owners Should Know
item.description: Lead paint in older homes, explained: why pre-1978 houses matter, where to look, why you never sand or scrape, and when to call a certified lead pro.

item.title: Monthly Home Maintenance Checklist: The 10-Minute House Walk
item.description: A monthly home maintenance checklist you can finish in 10 minutes: a simple house walk that catches leaks, cracks and safety problems early.

item.title: Nightly Home Safety Checklist: 7 Things to Do Before Bed
item.description: A simple nightly home safety checklist: 7 things to do before bed, from the stove and dryer to doors, chargers and space heaters. Takes about two minutes.

item.title: Older Electrical Panels: Fuse Boxes, Brands and Warning Signs
item.description: Older electrical panels explained: fuse boxes, panel brands inspectors often flag, warning signs like heat or buzzing, and why only electricians open one.

item.title: Polybutylene Pipes and Galvanized Pipes: How to Spot Them
item.description: Polybutylene pipes and old galvanized steel pipes: how to identify them, the warning signs to watch for, and when to call a licensed plumber.

item.title: Questions to Ask the Seller When Buying a House
item.description: Questions to ask the seller when buying a house: roof age, water history, repairs, permits, radon, sewer and insurance claims — and how to follow up.

item.title: Radon Testing: A Plain Guide for Homeowners
item.description: Radon testing made simple: what radon is, how to test with a home kit, what EPA's 4 pCi/L action level means, and when to call a mitigation pro.

item.title: Sewer Scope Inspection: What It Is and When to Get One
item.description: A sewer scope inspection puts a camera down the line from house to street. What it finds, when to get one before buying, and how to read the results.

item.title: Signs of Water in a Basement: What to Look and Smell For
item.description: Signs of water in a basement you can spot yourself: stains, white powder, musty smells, rust and fresh paint — plus where it comes from and who to call.

item.title: Smoke and Carbon Monoxide Detector Placement: A Plain Guide
item.description: Smoke and carbon monoxide detector placement made simple: which rooms and levels need alarms, where not to mount them, testing, and when to replace.

item.title: Spring Home Maintenance Checklist: What to Check After Winter
item.description: A practical spring home maintenance checklist: roof, gutters, foundation, sump pump, faucets and AC — what to check yourself and when to call a pro.

item.title: Summer Storm Prep for Your House: A Calm, Practical Checklist
item.description: Summer storm prep for your house: trees, gutters, sump pump, loose items, power outages and generator safety — what to do yourself and when to call a pro.

item.title: Water Heater Warning Signs (and How to Tell Its Age)
item.description: Water heater warning signs to watch for, how to read its age from the label, and what to look at on the relief valve before you call a plumber.

item.title: What Does a Home Inspection Cover (and What It Doesn't)
item.description: What does a home inspection cover? The systems a general inspector looks at, why it's visual and non-invasive, what's usually excluded, and what to add.

item.title: Winterize Your House Checklist: What to Do Before the First Freeze
item.description: A plain-English winterize your house checklist: pipes, faucets, heating, roof, gutters and alarms to check before the first freeze, and when to call a pro.
